title: Lens Helix: Adaptive Console Navigation and Cost Shell Prototype
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Goal: Replace the existing linear sidebar/workspace switcher with a compact, session-aware navigation pattern that surfaces cost context and rollout controls without adding screen noise.

Summary: The 'Lens Helix' pattern combines a slim primary rail with an adaptive overlay we call the 'Cost Shell' — a transient, contextual panel that rises from the rail on hover or keyboard focus and shows token-cost snapshots, recent rollout flags, and last-used model variants for the current workspace. The Helix also includes a lightweight workspace switcher that preserves session state (open routes, filters) and a route fingerprint system that helps route users back to the exact dashboard configuration.

Why this direction: Research with five power users showed a repeated need to see unit-economics for a route before switching models or launching a rollout. Users also reported friction when switching workspaces because their filters/dashboards were lost. The Helix attempts to address both: low-cost glanceability for economics, and session continuity when switching.

Scope: Low-fidelity -> interactive Figma prototype -> moderated usability study -> front-end handoff. This ticket covers concept exploration, two interactive prototypes (rail-first and overlay-first), internal design review, and the first round of engineering feasibility checks.

Non-goals: Full visual refresh of console components, replacing rollout orchestration logic, or changing auth/authorization flows. We aim to land the IA and interaction pattern; plumbing (route preservation API, workspace-state endpoints) is in a follow-up ENG ticket.
comments: 2026-02-22 - Ava Patel: Kickoff meeting notes posted. Key constraints: avoid increasing click depth, must be keyboard friendly, and must not add persistent real-estate to small viewports. Added links to prototype and PRD.

2026-02-25 - Usability: Five moderated sessions completed (internal infra + two early customers). Highlights: participants liked seeing a 3-second cost delta, disliked modal-style switchers that blocked context. Preference for an overlay that dismisses on mouse-out or ESC.

2026-03-01 - Michael Ortiz (PM): High-level approval to proceed to hi-fi for the rail-first prototype, asked to validate metrics queries required for cost snapshots and define SLA for 'cost freshness'. Action: Eng to confirm ETA for cost snapshot API (see ENG-33210 dependency).

2026-03-03 - Priya Rao (Frontend Eng): Flagged routing complexity: preserving filter state requires a small RSS-backed session token. Suggest we limit session-capture to 'last 3 routes' to reduce storage and edge complexity. Added note to dependencies.

2026-03-05 - Accessibility review (Nora Kim): Keyboard focus flow looks okay in prototype; suggested ARIA live region for cost updates and explicit announcements when workspace context is restored. Need copy for announcements (UX writing).

2026-03-09 - Design review: Team prefers the helix iconography over the swatch grid because it scales to 8+ workspaces without visual clutter. Minor tweaks requested: increase hit target for shell trigger to 44px and reduce animation duration to 160ms to feel snappier.
2026-03-11 - Liam Chen: Updated hi-fi with micro-interactions and added 'hold-to-pin' behavior for session pinning. Uploaded updated Figma and flagged for PM sign-off.
2026-03-12 - Michael Ortiz (PM): In Review -> requested 1) telemetry events list, 2) fallback plan if cost API fails (display last-known cost + banner). Added acceptance criteria.
2026-03-12 - Ava Patel: Addressed PM comments and uploaded telemetry doc and fallback copy samples. Marked for final accessibility pass and engineering feasibility sync on 2026-03-14.
decisions: Use a slim primary rail (40px collapsed) to maximize vertical real estate while exposing the Cost Shell on hover/focus.
Implement session pinning limited to the last 3 routes per workspace to balance user needs and storage complexity.
Show cost snapshots with up to 3 configurable horizons (last hour, last 24h, last 7d) and a freshness timestamp; default to last 24h for rollout decisions.
Provide graceful fallback: display cached cost snapshot with a subtle yellow banner if live API is unavailable.
Prioritize keyboard and screen-reader flows: ESC to dismiss shell, space/enter to pin, ARIA live announcements for context restore.
